materials.name: PegaClad 1

thickness_range.steps_note: 0.004 to 0.030 in, in sheet or panel form

materials.notes: Very low loss, high thermal reliability laminate and prepreg (core TU-1300E, prepreg TU-1300P E) for RF, mmWave, automotive radar and base station antennas, compatible with modified FR-4 processes. IPC-4103/17 validation (QPL); UL file E189572; maximum operating temperature 140 C. The thermal coefficient of Dk is +30 ppm/C (-40 to 140 C); electric strength above 40 kV/mm; X/Y CTE 15-17 ppm/C below Tg; z-axis CTE 35 ppm/C below Tg, 250 above and 2.5 % (-50 to 260 C); dimensional stability below 0.3 mm/m; T260, T288 and T300 above 60 min, solder float 288 C above 120 s; flexural strength above 60000 psi lengthwise and 50000 psi crosswise; peel strength 4-7 lb/in (1 oz foil); water absorption below 0.06 %; frequency drift below 40 MHz at 28 GHz (-40 to 140 C). Resistivity 1.3e11 M-ohm cm and 4.3e9 M-ohm converted. Copper cladding 1/2 to 2 oz.

materials.name: PegaClad 2

thickness_range.steps_note: 0.004 to 0.035 in, in sheet or panel form

materials.notes: Super low loss, high thermal reliability laminate and prepreg (core TU-1300N, prepreg TU-1300P N) whose electrical performance is competitive with PTFE laminates, for RF, mmWave, automotive radar and base station antennas. IPC-4103/17 validation (QPL); UL file E189572; maximum operating temperature 140 C. The thermal coefficient of Dk is +30 ppm/C (-40 to 140 C); electric strength above 40 kV/mm; X/Y CTE 15-17 ppm/C below Tg; z-axis CTE 35 ppm/C below Tg, 250 above and 2.5 % (-50 to 260 C); T260, T288 and T300 above 60 min, solder float 288 C above 120 s; flexural strength above 60000 psi lengthwise and 50000 psi crosswise; peel strength 4-7 lb/in (1 oz foil); water absorption below 0.06 %; frequency drift below 40 MHz at 38 GHz. Resistivity converted from M-ohm cm and M-ohm. Copper cladding 1/2 to 2 oz.

materials.name: PegaClad 2A
materials.notes: Super low loss laminate and prepreg (core TU-1400, prepreg TU-1400P), Dk 3.0, for mmWave and automotive radar and Wi-Fi antennas; compatible with hybrid multilayers with FR-4 and low loss prepregs. UL file E189572 (under registration on the sheet); maximum operating temperature 140 C. The expansion values (X/Y 13 ppm/C, z 40 and 220 ppm/C, 2.7 %) are for resin content 50 %; dimensional stability below 0.3 mils/inch; T288 and T300 above 60 min, solder float 288 C above 120 s; flexural strength above 51000 psi lengthwise and 46000 psi crosswise; peel strength above 4 lb/in (1 oz HVLP foil); water absorption below 0.1 %; electric strength above 40 kV/mm; volume resistivity above 1e10 M-ohm cm and surface resistivity above 1e8 M-ohm. Thicknesses 0.005, 0.0075 and 0.010 in.

materials.name: PegaClad 300
materials.notes: Very low loss laminate and prepreg (core TU-1400, prepreg TU-1400P, E-glass), Dk 3.0, for antennas and low-orbit satellites. Prepreg glass styles 1027, 1037, 1067 and 1078. UL file E189572; maximum operating temperature 140 C. The expansion values (X/Y 13 ppm/C, z 40 and 220 ppm/C, 2.7 %) are for resin content 50 %; T260, T288 and T300 above 60 min, solder float 288 C above 120 s; flexural strength above 50000 psi lengthwise and 45000 psi crosswise; peel strength above 4 lb/in (1 oz VLP foil); water absorption below 0.1 %; electric strength above 40 kV/mm; resistivity above 1e10 M-ohm cm and 1e8 M-ohm. Thicknesses 0.020, 0.030 and 0.060 in.

materials.name: PegaClad 338-345-365
materials.notes: Series of three Dk grades (3.38, 3.45 and 3.65, tolerance +/- 0.05 at 10 GHz) of a hydrocarbon-based very low loss laminate and prepreg (core TU-1300, prepreg TU-1300P) for sub-6 GHz antennas with low PIM requirements; prepreg 1078, 1086 and 3313 in panel form. The Dk and Df points are the three grades, in the order 3.38, 3.45 and 3.65. IPC-4103/17; UL file E189572; maximum operating temperature 140 C. The thermal coefficient of Dk is 30 ppm/C; X/Y CTE 13-16 ppm/C below Tg; z-axis CTE 35 ppm/C below Tg, 200 above and 1.7 %; T260, T288 and T300 above 60 min, solder float 288 C above 120 s; flexural strength above 50000 psi lengthwise and 40000 psi crosswise; peel strength 4-5 lb/in (1 oz HVLP foil); water absorption 0.06 % (Dk 3.65, 60 mil); electric strength above 40 kV/mm. Resistivity (about 1.3e11 M-ohm cm and 4.3e9 M-ohm) converted. Copper 1/2 and 1 oz, RTF, VLP or HVLP.
